The therapy speech in your words; the drive and "Will that even cut it?" gone; the car park opens on "Tarquin stops for supplies…".
Bob from the tent ("I hate these wank tanks… I miss my wife"), "two worlds collide", and only two of Tarquin's insults; Bob's lines trimmed; no 4x4s.
The trip: the vortex out, the fog, the bending trees, the river turning into a snake and the river of gold, fading into each other.
"Sweet dreams, Tarquin." and "Where the fuck am I?"

11 dark cards with yellow words are new shots still to be made: the City and the NatWest Tower, two trading-floor shots, Tarquin's second angle, the car from outside, the wide car park, Bob looking out at the wank tank, Bob and Tarquin in one frame, and 28 and 67 without the beer.
